newsitem.title: UK: Safeway up further after upbeat comment.
newsitem.headline: Safeway up further after upbeat comment.

text.p: Shares in Safeway Plc rose on Tuesday amid further reaction to recent upbeat comment on the stock and as speculation of a possible bid for Littlewoods stores weighed on rivals, dealers and analysts said.

Sources said Safeway continued to benefit from comment from Safeway at a food retail conference hosted last week by Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, which continues to rate the stock a "buy." The stock was up 7p at 372 by 1255 GMT.
Merrill Lynch also issued a "buy" on Safeway last week.
Separately Tesco Plc and ASDA Group Plc were seen among the likely bidders for the stores chain put up for sale by privately-owned Littlewoods.
"In my view there are only two candidates, Tesco and ASDA," said one analyst, who asked not to be named.
J. Sainsbury Plc, also seen as not likely to bid for the Littlewoods stores, was up 5-1/2p at 313-1/2.
Tesco was unchanged at 340-1/2p and ASDA was down 1/4p at 111-1/2.
